name: creative-bucket-tank
description: A creative player using a bucket on a Tank keeps the bucket and is given the result only when the inventory holds none like it (vanilla ItemUtils.createFilledResult; Forge parity, #213).

steps.label: pour the water bucket into the empty tank
the water bucket is still in hand
steps.run: execute if items entity @p weapon.mainhand minecraft:water_bucket

steps.label: one empty bucket was given
steps.run: execute if items entity @p container.* minecraft:bucket

steps.label: pour again, with an empty bucket already held
still exactly one empty bucket
steps.run: execute if items entity @p container.* minecraft:bucket

steps.label: only an empty bucket now
run: item replace entity @p weapon.mainhand with minecraft:bucket

steps.label: fill the empty bucket from the tank
the empty bucket is still in hand
steps.run: execute if items entity @p weapon.mainhand minecraft:bucket

steps.label: one water bucket was given
steps.run: execute if items entity @p container.* minecraft:water_bucket

steps.name: after
steps.look: tank with water; hotbar: empty bucket in hand, a water bucket beside it
